channel.title: AgentC
channel.description: AgentC is an agentic-AI marketing agency: AI agents run research, creative and optimisation loops while human strategists own judgement and taste.

item.title: What is agentic marketing, and who conducts the agents?
item.description: Agentic marketing uses AI agents to run research, creative and optimisation loops. Here is how it works and why a human conductor still decides.

item.title: Human-in-the-loop marketing: where to put the checkpoints
item.description: Human-in-the-loop marketing only works if checkpoints sit in the right places. A practical map of what agents decide alone and what waits for a person.

item.title: How to govern AI marketing agents: a one-page charter
item.description: AI marketing agents need written rules before they need more autonomy. A one-page governance charter covering scope, data, approvals and accountability.

item.title: The future marketing org: fewer handoffs, more conductors
item.description: How AI agents reshape the marketing team: which roles shrink, which grow, and why the conductor becomes the most important job in the department.

item.title: Keeping human connection in automated marketing
item.description: Automation can scale reach while quietly eroding trust. Five design rules for keeping real human connection inside AI-run marketing.

item.title: How AI agents do audience research without guessing
item.description: AI research agents are only as good as their evidence. How AgentC runs a continuous audience research loop on SOMIN that strategists can verify.

item.title: Why AI creative needs a human edit, and what to cut
item.description: AI agents make creative options abundant. Taste becomes the scarce skill. A practical editing routine for choosing and shaping agent-made creative.

item.title: Optimisation agents and the vanity metric trap
item.description: Optimisation agents chase whatever you tell them to. How to point them at true profit instead of vanity ROAS, and when humans should overrule.

item.title: Why every AI agent decision needs an audit trail
item.description: If you cannot explain what your marketing agents did and why, you cannot defend it. What a useful agent audit trail records, and who reads it.

item.title: How to brief AI agents: a brief template for conductors
item.description: A good agent brief sets purpose, boundaries and taste, not just tasks. A practical template for briefing AI marketing agents, with a worked example.
